surface_mechanism: The bestowed tongue and two lips establish embodied speech and moral communication before the choice of two elevated paths.
Guidance is tested by the difficult ascent: release from captivity or feeding during a day of hunger.
The recipients make the ethical demand concrete: a related orphan and a destitute person brought down to the dust.
The dominant secondary network joins guidance, purposeful effort, difficult terrain, liberation law, bodily vulnerability, food provision, kinship obligation, poverty, and mercy.
